cohort: 160 women who delivered at term by cesarean section, 80 with pre-existing thrombophilia and 80 without thrombophilia (control group).
finding: Postpartum uterine involution was not significantly different between treated thrombophilia patients and non-thrombophilia patients after cesarean section.
mod_finding: Postpartum uterine involution was not significantly different after cesarean section between treated thrombophilia patients and non-thrombophilia patients.
